entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I received a VeloBand Pulse for Christmas, and I need to... I think I need to return it. The website is just so confusing.
I can certainly help you look into a return. I'm sorry to hear the website was confusing. To get started, can I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VFP-77813.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 24th. Now, just to make sure I get this routed correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a personal preference?

Oh, it's not broken. It's just... right after the holidays, we had a family emergency. My husband had a fall and we had to rush him to the hospital. It was all very sudden, and he needed surgery. I haven't even had a moment to think about this device. Can't you just help me? I feel so overwhelmed.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful, and please don't worry about a thing. I can absolutely help you with this. Let me just pull up our return policy information.
Okay, I've just reviewed the policy in my system. It looks like you have nothing to worry about. All VeloFit products can be returned within 90 days of delivery.
Really? Ninety days? The little card in the box said something about ten days for Pulse products and I started to panic. I thought I had missed it with everything going on.

I apologize for any confusing information. My system is clear that it's a 90-day window. Since you only received it 10 days ago, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I'm processing that for you now and emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label.
Oh, what a relief. Thank you so much, David. That's one less thing to worry about.

You are very welcome, Sarah. And given the circumstances, and since you're a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for the trouble. I truly hope your husband has a quick and smooth recovery.
That's so kind of you. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
You're welcome. Please take care, and have a good day.
